# LOG-001: journald has a size cap

- **Group:** Logs and monitoring
- **Severity when it fails:** low
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Without SystemMaxUse the journal may use 10 percent of the filesystem, up to 4G. On a small VPS that is a large share of the disk, and a log flood can fill it.

## Verify by hand

```sh
systemd-analyze cat-config systemd/journald.conf; journalctl --disk-usage
```

## How to fix it

Add a drop-in /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/size.conf with `[Journal]` and `SystemMaxUse=1G`, then restart systemd-journald.

Run `stackward explain LOG-001` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
